notes.title: New Update for RPG Fighter League - 5 April 2019
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Here a list of all the tweaks, bugs fixes and others things I was working to upgrade the quality of the game. 

5 April 2019
=================================
[list]
[*] Earth Titan Ram and Frost Ram Titan give better item if you want them. Drop 1 on 3 give the right item or you can try to steal but good luck on that.
[*] Ram Titan are now 1 on 3 chances to be in the leagues. Gentle, Learning, Advanced, Major, Master, Sheep
[*] Add somes weapons for James pistols in the weapons departement seller.
[*] Add Widow Ram Titan in Sheep League. A mid range ram with some mid range reward.
[*] Tweaks some magic to cost least to better balancing and choices.
[*] Weapons craft IV is missing will be added shortly in a store near by ;)
[*] If you go see Colette the wife of the craftman in the hall of champions she will reward you great craft book if you have enough fans :) 
[*] More enemies drop Craft Scrap overall to easily craft weapons and armors.
[*] Add one song in the Piano Hall and working in the feature to always keep the song you choose.
[*] Debug the Goldie Ghost in the Solid League.
[*] Tweak Enemies stats of the Solid League.
[*] Reduce the number of battle to increase the friendship level with all characters.
[*] NEw books of xp and sp in the hall of champions sell by Elyssa.
[*] Add somes weapons types and armors to characters to be abke to weild more stuff in battle.
[*] Cure Jammer is now 1000 HP.
[*] Which NPC you want to have more good stuff to sell Celeste or Sylvane ??
[/list]

3 April 2019
================================
[list]
[*] Bigs fixes one element in hall of champion where you can go outside of the playable area.
[*] Now a lot of offensive spells tier 3 give more damage output for the MP.
[*] Tweaks some Mid Ether and others potions are now available to find around some monsters.
[*] I will think of a way to fight al the missing monsters and enemies from the bestiary in a special room :) 
[*] Tweak the cost for some big book XP.
[*] Spare Parts will give you a nice little object if you go speak with the robot in the Hall of Champions.
[*] I will look to a way to change the music of the Hall of Champions for good with the Piano and add some tracks.
[*] I continue to improve and debug the game overall.
[*] 
[/list]
2 April 2019
===============================

[list]
[*] SP are now more easily gain in battle by action and monsters defeated.
[*] Emil have more healing power and a lot of white and black spells have been tweaked to give more healing and damage output power to spell caster.
[*] TO prevent a time scaling bug in the battle system, it is now impossible to change your formation in a battle. You need to move the formation outside of battle. Let me know if you have issue on that changed.
[*] Corrections to somes labels for merchants in the Hall of Champion.
[*] Weapon Craft Book III give better weapons and recipes to have more useful tools to encounter elemental enemies.
[*] The Old Sage give better price on each treasure island if you exchange him some Baron Juice.
[*] Elyssa can sell you some big book of EXP to help you use your gold to find some exp for all the members of your team so even if you dont play a lot with a characters you can still level him up with somes coins.
[*] Somes others bugs fixes and tweaks around the game to have a better progression overall.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 28 March 2019 - RPG Fighter League - Bugs fixes and tweaks!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Here a list of tweaks and work i'm currently on for the game.
You just need to update your game to benifits from all the tweaks. If you see major bugs or anything you want to share with me, just let me know in the comment.

[b]28 March 2019
===============================[/b]
[list]
[*] Add somes gold and XP to overall a lot of monsters again to prevent to much grinding. I want people to complete the game and not just grind everything.
[*] I added an exit switch in cute league - Speak to the panel at the top of the cute league 2 times and they will ask you if you want to leave this place and return to the hall of champions.
[*] This is to prevent if you encounter a bug and then return in the cute league to see if thing return to normal. Thanks!
[*] I'm working in a middle mix league where you will fight a various combinasion of monsters you may have faced before to give you more unique challenge and easy way to get some xp and gold.
[/list]

[b]27 March 2019
===============================[/b]
[list]
[*] Bugs fixes in the cute league to make sure the flow go right. If not tell me I will try others things.
[*] Somes enemies gives more gold and exp so the game feel least grinding at the end
[*] some plans for futur make a middle ground league and a really really hard one with somes mixs ups fights.
[*] Somes others debugs around the game with all the comments I have found on Steam.
[/list]


[b]24 March 2019
===============================[/b]

[list]
[*] Tweaks somes monsters to attack with more states related attack for better challenge
[*] Add somes rings from Sylvane NPC to give a better control and resist against somes states in battle.
[*] Somes tips around the game were added to give more feedback to player when losing a fight.
[*] SP book now give 3000 SP like the description
[*] A lot of monsters give more gold and XP now a balance to been able to grind a bit least.
[*] Heal wounds is now a skills no more a magic by Emil Character.
[*] Somes weapons were tweaked to do some more damages.
[*] Debugs and others bugs fixes from the forum/discussion topic in steam.
[*] added some famupgrade1.png and fam1.png image to try to fix somes problems people have with others rpg maker games and saves files.
[/list]


[b]21 March 2019
===============================[/b]
[list]
[*] Saves files should be fines now at 1.3.3 but conflict might happen with other title. Check folder found it, its in C:\Users\[your user name]\AppData\Local\KADOKAWA Your saves files should be there
[*] Correction in MP Boosters now working for stats boost.
[*] Fix in the Architect league count when you succeed.
[*] Fix with Queen Mask now can resist blind.
[*] Tweak Valery to not have problem in her fight.
[*] Others fixes. Lets me know if you encounter weird bugs thanks.
[/list]

END
-Val

notes.title: Update 15 March 2019 - A new character to play and evolve with for RPG Fighter League.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A new weekend will start with some update for RPG Fighter League. I'm always reading your comments and questions and I want to make sure the game is great and fun to play. So I added a new character for you to recruit Sebastien. But at the same time, I try to tell myself to setup what I can to make sure the game is now in his final state. I will continue time to time to add some contents but now that the game can be finish. I want you to help me spread the words about the game. Any help is really appreciated and I'm still looking for you feedback.

Have a great weekend!

[list]
[*] Added the new character Sebastiens. He is a wise fighter who use the strong palm actions fights to defeat his enemy. Recruit him in the Hall of Champion after the event of the Master League.
[*] I added a Ram Titan monster in the Solid League for the one looking for a really hard challenge.
[*] You can now enter the secret hideout of Andrea in the Hall of Champion. You need to have her in your team and find the spot to enter to get the chance to discover some nices little secrets.
[*] I have made somes tweaks overall in the game for balancing and tweakings weapons, spells, monster for a better challenge.
[*] Debug others items, weapons and armors types on characters.
[*] The game should be complete by now. I hope you are having a blast playing Rpg Fighter League and I'm waiting for your help to get the game even better support and fun!
[/list]

notes.title: Update 10 March 2019 - Tweaks and bugs for you.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I have just submitted a latest build with some bugs fixes and tweaks to help you finish your quest of RPG Fighter League. I just want to say thank you to everyone who finds somes bugs or give me there feedback on the game so I can continue improve the whole experience. I hope you have a good time playing the game. I want to know more about how much time you have spent finishing the game and what was your favorite characters? 

thanks agains!
-Val

[list]
[*] You can now complet the game. A bug was preventing the player to go and meet the Architect. Now everything should be fine for you to fight one of the harder foes of the game.
[*] Another things, you can find Sephia or Karl in the Hall of Champions after your third encounter with them and chakal.
[*] They will be ready for you to go in your team for the final strech. 
[*] I have done several tweaks to somes spells and enemies to give a better challenge at the end of the game. So players strategies might be too good.
[*] I have fix some bug with Maxim recruit messaging.
[*] Added the Destiny Staff recipe for the final weapon for any good caster. 
[*] If you see some bugs let me know on the community hub on steam website so I can fix everything.
[*] Have fun!!
[/list]

notes.title: New Update of the Game for 24 Febuary 2019 - You can now finish the game!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Big news for the game! It's now possible to do a complete flow fomr the beginning of the game to the end with the credits and everything.
I'm really happy with this achievements!

[list]
[*] I added a new Solid League where every physical attack will have a hard time.
[*] The Architect League can now be done completly with his own treasures islands.
[*] I added 2 full playbables characters for you to recruit (Andrea and Zoey)
[*] I added 7 new achievements.
[*] I added some news books to find for ultimate crafting experience with weapons and armors. 
[*] A lot of debugs and tweaks around the game to make the experience better.
[/list]

But I hope that you will love the game and playing in something that become bigger and bigger each time a new version come up.
I can't wait to have your feedback on the whole experience.
I hope you will find it fun and challenging for you.
This is not a drill! You can see the end of the adventures of Henry and his teammates. 

Which team is the best?
-Val

notes.title: New Update after almost 2 years of the Steam.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Firstly I would like to apologie for all the players who were waiting for an update from the game. My life have drasticaly changes in the last 2 years but I haven't forget you or tha great game. I know a lot of people were waiting for this. But now you have it a new update for the game with more content, new leagues, new challenges, a lot of balances tweaks overall across the game.
It's not perfect and it's not the end of this project. But I'm pretty sure that if someone start a fresh game right now he have more then 15-20 hours of gameplay to discover everything in RPG Fighter League.

I'm still waiting for your feedback. How do you find the game? To easy? To hard? What kind of challenges or surprises do you want?

The game play overall better right now, with more stuff but with a better balance between the characters and enemies you face along the final victory.

I'm glad to be back.
Here a summary of what you have in the game right now.

[list]
[*] 14 playable characters that you can recruit to fight in the leagues. (3 More incoming)
[*] 13 leagues with all kind of differents enemies and challenges for you to overcome. (More incoming)
[*] 400+ items, pieces of equipments for your team.
[*] A lot of differents secrets to uncovers in the depth of the Hall of Champions.
[*] Millions of possibilities to create the best team to fight in the Fighter League.
[*] And a lot of fun ahead of you for the fighter in you.
[/list]

[b]Have a great time![/b]

-Val

notes.title: Update - Balance weapons, armor, monsters and new skills for Karl and Sephia
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Quick update about the game and some balacing I have done to give a better overall experience of the current content of the game.

*Emil, Rachelle and Sephia have now a better progression for their MP stats. *More MP mean more magic for you in battle.
*More monsters will drop Ethers items for you.
*You have now 50 seconds in the Bat Mania mini game. (Instead of 30)
*Fix the Inner Skill of Karl and added a Power breakdown skill for him.
*Added Magic Breakdown skill to Sephia.
*Added Heal Wounds skill to Emil. 
*More chests and nice treasures are added to the loot system in the Leagues.
*Monsters AGI have been tweak in many cases to represent better the higher stage of AGI from the team of the player.
*And a lot of others various tweaks to improve RPG Fighter League.

I just want to say thanks to everybody who play my game and any support with recommandations is really appreciated to give some visibility to my project. I continue my work to make sure the best can happen with this game for all fans and new players of RPG Fighter League.

notes.title: New Update 17 May with new playable character Jade and some nice features.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I just want to list the new changes and update of this version.

You can now recruit Jade the Dancer of Chaos in the Hall of Champion after your have done the Frozen Trophy I. Can you pass the Quiz to recruit her?

I added an option where you can change the font of the menu and texts in the game. It's still in development and testing but it's really great to have something different to offer and I know that some text might be cut right now. But I will see what I can do and if I can add other font.

I added some window skins for menu. This feature is still in development and I'm trying to have the best visual update for this. 

I continue my work on the game and thinking about the new leagues and others cool features to always improve the overall experience of the game. 

I always try to add some new stuffs from the beginning of the game and adding some nice secrets in every room of this game. So keep your eyes opens and this is only the beginning for RPG Fighter League. Thanks for all your support.

notes.title: New Speed Up mode in battle for RPG Fighter League + update 15 dec.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I just added in the latest version of RPG Fighter League a new Speed Up mode in battle where you can press and hold the Action Button (Space bar by default) to make the fight go faster. That really help sometime to just go fast foward in a easy fight and continue your journey in the league.

Or you can simply toggle the Speed Up more with the Shift Key. 
Another change I made in the game is that right now, the BP will not be depleted between too fight. You will stay with the same number of BP on your characters so you can use more skills to your advantage in battle.

Other tweaks have been made around the game and I added some new windows skins for your too choose you favorite one.

I hope you have fun playing RPG Fighter League and thanks for all the feedback and any reviews of the game in his current state (Early Access) is welcome.

The next update will be about new league and a new character named Jade that you will be able to recruit in the Hall of Champions.

Have fun!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26735902/f6eccaf7518d7b0e18f134e4c0ddf14b797d8e03.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26735902/cefaa6a044d92646a441b192299a5bbabe716635.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26735902/3396bb996f5a209ec74e4372c9d99963a1457055.jpg[/img]
